resources.string: Checks that MZGram settings survive a restart. It changes nothing else.
Show exact counts of views, reactions and members: 4777 instead of 4.8K.
An empty chat shows only its title, without the suggested sticker to send.
In channels where you cannot post, hides the bottom bar with the mute button.
Videos that come in several qualities play in the original one, which uses more data.
Removes the stories row from the chat list. Stories in profiles stay. Takes effect after a restart.
The attach menu no longer starts a live camera preview; a camera button opens the camera when needed.
Pulling the chat list down past the archive row opens the archive.
Show a confirmation before a voice or video call starts.
Message times show seconds, such as 12:34:56. Applies to screens opened after the change.
